seo.title: Kavanagh & Sons | Plumber & Heating Engineer in Kilkenny
seo.description: Family plumbing and heating firm covering Kilkenny City, Thomastown, Callan and Castlecomer. Boiler servicing, bathrooms and leak repairs. Call Tom on 056 776 2143.

hero.headline: Kilkenny’s family plumbers, one call away.
hero.subhead: Boilers serviced, leaks found and fixed, bathrooms fitted properly. Tom answers the phone himself.

image.alt: Copper pipework being fitted under a kitchen sink

items.title: Family-run
items.text: Tom and his two sons do the work themselves.

items.title: Straight answers
items.text: A time you can hold us to and a price before we start.

items.title: Left tidy
items.text: Dust sheets down, everything cleared away after.

services.heading: What we do
services.intro: Domestic plumbing and heating for homes across the county, from a dripping tap to a full heating system.

items.title: Boiler service & repair
items.text: Annual services, breakdowns and pressure problems on oil and gas boilers.

items.title: Heating systems
items.text: Radiators added or moved, power flushes, pumps and zone controls.

items.title: Bathrooms & showers
items.text: Full bathroom fits, electric and pumped showers, wet rooms.

items.title: Leaks & burst pipes
items.text: Traced, fixed and made good, with as little disruption as possible.

items.title: Taps, toilets & cylinders
items.text: Replacements and repairs, including hot water cylinders and immersions.

items.title: Winter callouts
items.text: Frozen pipes and no heat in a cold snap. Ring early and we'll fit you in.

about.heading: Three of us, one van, and our name on every job.
body: Tom Kavanagh has been fixing boilers and plumbing houses around Kilkenny since he was an apprentice. These days his sons Conor and Mark work alongside him.
We keep the business small on purpose. The person who quotes the job is the person who turns up to do it, and if something isn't right afterwards, you ring the same number.

image.alt: A plumber's toolbag open on a workbench

process.heading: How it works
process.intro: No call centre and no waiting in for a window that never comes.

steps.title: Ring or send a message
steps.text: Tell us what's wrong or what you're planning. Photos help.

steps.title: We call out and quote
steps.text: A fixed price before any work starts, and a date you can plan around.

steps.title: The job gets done
steps.text: Fitted properly, tested, and the place left as we found it.

items.author: Siobhán D.
items.text: Boiler died on a Sunday night in January. Tom was out first thing Monday, had the part by lunchtime and the heat back on before the kids got home. Couldn't recommend them more.

items.author: Pádraig M.
items.text: They fitted our new bathroom. Tidy, on time and the price didn't change once. Conor was great to deal with.

items.author: Helen R.
items.text: Found a leak two other lads couldn't. Honest and fair.

items.author: John K.
items.text: Good job on the radiators, would use again. Had to wait a week for a slot but it was worth it.

area.heading: Where we work
area.intro: Based in Kilkenny City and out every day across the county.
area.note: Just outside these? Ring and ask.

cta.heading: No heat, a leak, or a bathroom to plan?
cta.text: Ring Tom directly. If he's on a job he'll call you back the same day.

contact.heading: Get a quote
contact.intro: Tell us a bit about the job and we'll come back to you, usually the same day.
contact.success: Thanks, that's with us. We'll be in touch today or first thing tomorrow.

footer.blurb: Family plumbing and heating in Kilkenny since the 1990s.
